```{r list files in each folder}
# Read each file into a named list
xlsx_list_72hpf <- setNames(
                      lapply(resaz_72hpf_filenames, read_excel),
                      str_remove(basename(resaz_72hpf_filenames), "\\.xlsx$")
             )


xlsx_list_15dpf <- setNames(
                      lapply(resaz_15dpf_filenames, read_excel),
                      str_remove(basename(resaz_15dpf_filenames), "\\.xlsx$")
             )

xlsx_list_48dpf <- setNames(
                      lapply(resaz_48dpf_filenames, read_excel),
                      str_remove(basename(resaz_48dpf_filenames), "\\.xlsx$")
             )



```

```{r call the convert_to_df function}
source("scripts/convert_to_df.R")
```



```{r 72 hpf compile raw data}

loop.df           <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = 1, ncol = 8)) # create dataframe to save cumunalitively during for loop
colnames(loop.df) <- c('filename', 'time', 'timepoint', 'Plate_row', 'Plate_col', 'Well', 'plate', 'flourescence') # names for columns in the for loop
rbind.df          <- data.frame() # start dataframe 
for (i in 1:length(resaz_72hpf_filenames)) {
  
 x         <- (basename(resaz_72hpf_filenames[i]))
 x.2       <- sub("\\.xlsx$", "", noquote(x))
 loop.df   <- covert_to_df(xlsx_list_72hpf[[x.2]])
 
 rbind.df <- rbind(rbind.df,
                     loop.df) #bind to a cumulative list dataframe
 print(rbind.df) # print to monitor progress
  
}


rbind.df_72hpf <- rbind.df %>% 
                    dplyr::mutate(Date = 20260320,
                                  Treatment = dplyr::case_when(gsub("^(?:[^_]*_){2}([^_]*).*", "\\1",filename) == "low" ~ "26C",
                                                        gsub("^(?:[^_]*_){2}([^_]*).*", "\\1",filename) == "high" ~ "38C"),
                                  PlateID = gsub("^[^_]+_([^_]+_[^_]+)_.*", "\\1", filename))

data_merged_72hpf <- dplyr::left_join(rbind.df_72hpf,metadata_counts, by=c('Date','PlateID', 'Well', 'Plate_row', 'Treatment'))

```

```{r 72 hpf output}
write.csv(data_merged_72hpf,  "output/raw/resazurin/rawdf_72hpf.csv")
```



```{r 15 dpf compile raw data}
loop.df           <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = 1, ncol = 8)) # create dataframe to save cumunalitively during for loop
colnames(loop.df) <- c('filename', 'time', 'timepoint', 'Plate_row', 'Plate_col', 'Well', 'plate', 'flourescence') # names for columns in the for loop
rbind.df          <- data.frame() # start dataframe 
for (i in 1:length(resaz_15dpf_filenames)) {
  
 x         <- (basename(resaz_15dpf_filenames[i]))
 x.2       <- sub("\\.xlsx$", "", noquote(x))
 loop.df   <- covert_to_df(xlsx_list_15dpf[[x.2]])
 
 rbind.df <- rbind(rbind.df,
                     loop.df) #bind to a cumulative list dataframe
 print(rbind.df) # print to monitor progress
  
}


rbind.df_15dpf <- rbind.df %>% 
                    dplyr::mutate(Date = 20260401,
                                  Treatment = dplyr::case_when(plate == 1 ~ "26C",
                                                        plate == 2 ~ "30C",
                                                        plate == 3 ~ "34C",
                                                        plate == 4 ~ "38C"),
                                  PlateID = dplyr::case_when(plate == 1 ~ "plate_1_26",
                                                        plate == 2 ~ "plate_2_30",
                                                        plate == 3 ~ "plate_3_34",
                                                        plate == 4 ~ "plate_4_38"))
rbind.df_15dpf$time
data_merged_15dpf <- dplyr::left_join(rbind.df_15dpf,metadata_counts, by=c('Date','PlateID', 'Well', 'Plate_row', 'Treatment'))

```


```{r 15 dpf output}
write.csv(data_merged_15dpf,  "output/resazurin/raw/rawdf_15dpf.csv")
```


```{r 48 dpf compile raw data}
loop.df           <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = 1, ncol = 8)) # create dataframe to save cumunalitively during for loop
colnames(loop.df) <- c('filename', 'time', 'timepoint', 'Plate_row', 'Plate_col', 'Well', 'plate', 'flourescence') # names for columns in the for loop
rbind.df          <- data.frame() # start dataframe 
for (i in 1:length(resaz_48dpf_filenames)) {
  
 x         <- (basename(resaz_48dpf_filenames[i]))
 x.2       <- sub("\\.xlsx$", "", noquote(x))
 loop.df   <- covert_to_df(xlsx_list_48dpf[[x.2]])
 
 rbind.df <- rbind(rbind.df,
                     loop.df) #bind to a cumulative list dataframe
 print(rbind.df) # print to monitor progress
  
}


rbind.df_48dpf <- rbind.df %>% # note, the names of the files differ from the previous time;oint, so made adjustments here
                    dplyr::mutate(Date = 20260504,
                                  Treatment = dplyr::case_when(
                                                        grepl("26C", plate, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "26C", # I assumed plates 1-4 are in line with temp, checl with Anna
                                                        grepl("30C", plate, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "30C",
                                                        grepl("34C", plate, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "34C",
                                                        grepl("38C", plate, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "38C"),
                                  PlateID = dplyr::case_when(
                                                        grepl("26C", plate, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "plate_1_26",
                                                        grepl("30C", plate, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "plate_2_30",
                                                        grepl("34C", plate, ignore.case = TRUE) ~"plate_3_34",
                                                        grepl("38C", plate, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "plate_4_38"))



data_merged_48dpf <- dplyr::left_join(rbind.df_48dpf,metadata_counts, by=c('Date','PlateID', 'Well', 'Plate_row', 'Treatment'))


```


```{r 48 dpf output}
write.csv(data_merged_48dpf,  "output/resazurin/raw/rawdf_48dpf.csv")
```
